svg.text: one document; the wrapper tags hide every binary region, the hidden body hides the rest
finds the eocd from the end of the file, then reads only what the central directory points at
finds %PDF- starting at offset 1024 or lower; every offset in the document is relative to that position
walks chunks from the signature; the declared lengths of the two tEXt chunks skip all foreign bytes
re-encodes the parsed characters of the hidden zip region back into bytes, guided by extra-data
Every row is the same file (the all-four-faces variant of the byte map); solid blocks are the bytes that reader interprets, faded blocks the bytes it ignores.
